items.title: Verify exact staging archive members before upload
items.why: deploy-staging hashes and uploads the tar without comparing its member list. A remote count does not detect same-count substitution. Source admission also follows symlinks.
items.recipe: Reuse existing tar listing and fail closed on ambiguous names; compare exact unique inventory against the admitted regular-file manifest before scp, and bind inventory digest/count to the staging receipt. Reject symlink sources and parents before packaging. Test actual tar substitutions and unsafe inputs.
items.acceptance: Actual archives accept exact names including spaces and long paths; reject missing, unexpected, duplicate and malformed members, unsafe source links/directories/traversal, corrupt or truncated archives. A real full staging deploy records matching inventory before upload; full required checks and production readback pass.
items.userOutcome: Prevent missing or substituted public pages/assets from reaching visitors through a count-only deployment check.
items.stageRationale: Stabilize current public release without changing identity, pricing or user flows.
